messages:
jess: quick heads-up — nightly link-scan found 12 dead links across /kb/ and /runbooks. report: https://internal.redwood/scans/1912345678  I pulled the top 6 that are 404s and a few broken anchors. can someone owning these areas claim them? @maria tagging you since you touched KB ownership last quarter
linkbot: automated scan summary: 12 dead links (6 404s, 4 broken anchors, 2 403 images). full CSV attached to report above.
maria: thanks jess — can you paste the top 6 paths here? i'll triage and split into PRs.
jess: pasted the smallest set (will keep short):
```
/kb/ops/deploy-guide -> /kb/deployments/ (404)
/kb/platform/infra-layout#zones -> anchor missing (anchor changed to #regions)
/runbooks/failover.md -> image /assets/failover-arch.png (403)
/runbooks/db-restore.md#step-4 -> anchor missing
/kb/quickstart/getting-started.md -> internal shortlink -> 404
/kb/observability/tracing.md -> link to old trace-sample repo (404)
```
sam: i own /kb/quickstart and /kb/observability — i can take the two quickstart/observability fixes. i should be able to do one PR for redirects + update the trace link to the new repo.
priya: i'll take the runbooks (failover + db-restore). the image 403 might be a bucket perms issue — if it's private we should reupload to docs-cdn. pinging infra (eng-docs) if they can check S3 ACLs.
maria: i'll split responsibilities and make INT ticket to track. creating INT-412 and assigning sam+priya. sam — please include redirects for the shortlink in your PR; prefer 301s where appropriate.
sam: got it. quick question: for anchor changes (infra-layout#zones -> #regions) do we want to keep a legacy anchor or update all inbound links? small script could rewrite internal links.
jess: lean to keep legacy anchors via a small redirect/anchor alias where possible. if that’s hairy, update top inbound links and add a brief redirect at the frontend.
eng-docs: note — any change that alters anchors needs a docs build and a prod deploy of the static site (small window). please tag @eng-oncall for the deploy.
priya: re: image 403 — opened infra ticket INF-789 asking for bucket ACL check and temporary signed URL while we re-upload.
sam: created PR draft: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/224 — includes redirects, link updates, and a minor wording fix. requesting review from @maria and @eng-docs.
jess: awesome, thanks. i added a tiny test to the scan harness to treat the trace repo link as a replaceable mapping. once PR merged can @linkbot re-run scan? :thumbsup:
linkbot: scheduled re-scan in 10 minutes; will post results to this thread.
maria: TY! i'll assign reviews and try to batch the obvious 404->redirect fixes into one PR to reduce churn.
priya: i'll pick up the runbook edits and reupload the image if INF-789 confirms we need to. will add a changelog note.
sam: pinging reviewers in PR. if anyone wants to split, LMK.
jess: thanks all — marking this as low-to-medium priority except runbook failover which is P1 for on-call docs. will update INT-412 accordingly.
